asset_spec.description: AssetSpec shape per upstream reference/v0.3-rc1/assets.py. Exactly one is declared: KRW, whole won, max_atoms is the pinned FSM MONEY_MAX fixture bound (not a registry limit). PROVISIONAL per docs/decisions/CAPITAL_UPSTREAM_BINDING.md section 3.6. A command body may carry it as the optional asset field; any other value is rejected ASSET_MISMATCH (400) before the command is applied, with no journal entry and no receipt. Asset registry DEFERRED, FX NOT_ADOPTED, amounts stay integers.
